column1: Your company is relatively untested by the Alyina Mercantile League. While we are aware of your reputation elsewhere, we approach such contracts cautiously. Initial deployments will include a close evaluation period to ensure your reliability aligns with our standards.
column2: 你们的公司对阿利纳商业同盟而言尚属未经检验。我们了解你们在别处的名声，但签订此类合约时向来谨慎。初次部署将包含一段密切评估期，以确保你们的可靠性与我们的标准相符。

column1: While your execution met acceptable standards, certain inefficiencies highlighted areas for improvement. We hope your next engagement will address these concerns, proving your adaptability and commitment.
column2: 你们的执行虽达到可接受标准，但某些低效之处凸显了改进空间。我们希望你们的下一次任务能解决这些问题，证明你们的适应力与担当。

column1: Your company has served us multiple times and your competence is evident, though minor setbacks in coordination and initiative have occasionally hindered operations. That said, your efforts have supported League goals, warranting continued engagement.
column2: 你们的公司已多次为我们效力，能力有目共睹，尽管协同与主动性上的小挫折偶尔妨碍了行动。话虽如此，你们的努力支持了同盟的目标，值得继续保持合作。

column1: Your company has demonstrated consistent dedication and skill during your tenure with the Alyina Mercantile League. Notable contributions in securing critical assets, coupled with your professionalism, have made you a valued resource in our operations.
column2: 在你们为阿利纳商业同盟效力期间，贵公司展现了始终如一的投入与技艺。在保障关键资产上的显著贡献，连同你们的专业素养，使你们成为我们行动中可贵的资源。

column1: Commander, {COMPANY.CompanyName} has become a cornerstone of our military strategy. Your efforts have proven critical in thwarting pirate and other factions incursions and defending League interests. We rely on your expertise as an integral part of our defense network.
column2: 指挥官，{COMPANY.CompanyName}已是我们军事战略的基石。你们的努力在挫败海盗及其他势力的入侵、捍卫同盟利益方面至关重要，是我们防御网络不可或缺的一环。

column1: Few mercenaries have achieved the level of success {COMPANY.CompanyName} has within the League. Your unwavering loyalty, superior tactics, and ability to train Militia personnel have significantly bolstered the AML's defensive capabilities. {COMPANY.CompanyName} is highly regarded.
column2: 很少有雇佣兵能取得{COMPANY.CompanyName}在同盟中所达到的成就。你们坚定不移的忠诚、高超的战术和训练民兵的能力，极大地强化了阿利纳商业同盟的防御能力。{COMPANY.CompanyName}备受推崇。

column1: Commander, {COMPANY.CompanyName} represents the very best the MRBC has to offer. Your contributions have been instrumental in shaping the Alyina Mercantile League's security. We turn to you first when a critical mission arises, as your reliability is unmatched, and your successes speak for themselves.
column2: 指挥官，{COMPANY.CompanyName}代表着雇佣兵评议会的最优秀水准。你们的贡献在塑造阿利纳商业同盟的安全格局上发挥了关键作用。有重大任务时，我们首先想到的就是你们，因为你们的可靠无可比拟，你们的成就自有明证。

column1: Commander, your team has exceeded expectations, securing our objectives with precision and professionalism. The Alyina Mercantile League is impressed by your performance, and we are eager to continue working with {COMPANY.CompanyName} on future operations.
column2: 指挥官，你们的团队超出了预期，以精确和专业完成了我们的目标。阿利纳商业同盟对你们的表现在印象深刻，我们渴望在未来的行动中继续与{COMPANY.CompanyName}合作。

column1: Commander, while the mission didn't succeed, your company's efforts were commendable. The League understands that unforeseen challenges played a significant role, and we appreciate your good-faith actions under difficult circumstances. This won't affect our consideration for future opportunities.
column2: 指挥官，任务虽未成功，但贵公司的努力值得称赞。同盟明白，无法预见的挑战起了很大作用，我们感谢你们在困难处境下的善意行动。这不会影响我们对未来机会的考虑。

column1: Commander, the Alyina Mercantile League cannot overlook the conduct of your company on this mission. Failures stemming from negligence or disregard for the contract have jeopardized League assets. You will need to undertake significant steps to address these shortcomings, or our partnership will be on hold.
column2: 指挥官，阿利纳商业同盟无法忽视贵公司此次任务的所作所为。因疏忽或无视合约而造成的失败，已经危及同盟的资产。你们必须采取重大措施弥补这些缺陷，否则我们的伙伴关系将暂时中止。

column1: I don't know why we bother offering you contracts, to be perfectly honest. It's obvious you're not a friend to the Amaris Empire and most likely an SLDF spy. Regardless, we find ourselves in desperate times, so we have to scrape the bottom of the barrel.
column2: 说实话，我不知道我们何必费心给你合约。你显然不是阿马里斯帝国的朋友，多半还是星际联盟防卫军的间谍。尽管如此，我们眼下处境艰难，所以只能到桶底去刮渣了。

column1: The Amaris Empire has a use for mercenaries like you, Commander. I think you'll be interested in the attached contract. It would be in your best interests that we come to a mutually beneficial agreement.
column2: 阿马里斯帝国用得上你这样的雇佣兵，指挥官。我想你会对随附的合约感兴趣。达成一项互利协议，对你我都有好处。

column1: The Amaris Empire would like to offer you a choice contract, Commander. As the leader of a respected mercenary company, you should find the terms fair.
column2: 阿马里斯帝国想向你提供一份精选合约，指挥官。作为一支受尊敬的雇佣兵公司的首领，你应该会觉得条款公道。

column1: Commander, I hope this message finds you well. The people of the Amaris Empire would like to extend a contract to you, as you have proven the value for your skills. Please consider it carefully.
column2: 指挥官，愿此信送达时您一切安好。阿马里斯帝国的人民想向您提供一份合约，因为您已经证明了自身才能的价值。请仔细考虑。

column1: Greetings, my friend. This contract is not one we would offer to a lesser mercenary, but you've proven your loyalty, prowess, and dedication to the ideals of the Amaris Empire. I hope you'll accept our offer.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。这份合约我们不会提供给次一等的雇佣兵，但你已证明了自己对阿马里斯帝国理想的忠诚、勇武与奉献。希望你能接受我们的提议。

column1: We both know the score, Commander. The Empire relies on you like you're one of our own, and you've always been there to help us out. I hope you can see fit to agree this time as well — this is a job too important for lesser warriors.
column2: 我们彼此心知肚明，指挥官。帝国倚重你，待你如自己人，而你也总在需要时伸出援手。希望这次你同样可以应允——这份活儿太重要，不能交给庸手。

column1: Top-tier work, Commander — The Empire is most pleased with your results. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 一流的活计，指挥官——帝国对你的成果非常满意。继续保持，我会确保有更多活儿找上你。

column1: The Amaris Empire understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a valiant, yet ineffective effort. We trust you will do better for the next battle.
column2: 阿马里斯帝国明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已付出了英勇却收效甚微的努力。我们相信下一场战斗你会做得更好。

column1: Your performance was appalling, Commander. Your efforts on the battlefield were no better than a rural militia, and not indicative of the leader of a reknowned mercenary company.
column2: 你的表现令人震惊，指挥官。你在战场上的发挥连乡间民兵都不如，根本不像一支著名雇佣兵公司的首领。

column1: In the Arc-Royal Liberty Coalition, we value honor above all. While your past may lack this virtue, we offer you a chance to earn both honor and payment. Prove your worth on the battlefield, and past misdeeds may be forgiven.
column2: 在弧光自由同盟，我们最看重荣誉。虽说你的过去或许缺乏这一美德，但我们给你一个同时赢得荣誉与报酬的机会。在战场上证明你的价值，过往的过失或可被宽恕。

column1: Mercenaries like you have the courage to face dangers that others might avoid. Join our cause, MechWarrior—fight alongside us, and be rewarded for your bravery and skill.
column2: 像你这样的雇佣兵有勇气直面他人避之不及的危险。加入我们的事业吧，机甲战士——与我们并肩作战，你的勇敢与技艺将得到报偿。

column1: Opportunities arise for those willing to seize them. This contract may suit your current standing, offering both challenge and reward. If you're prepared to fight for compensation, the Coalition is prepared to engage your services.
column2: 机会总是留给愿意把握它的人。这份合约或许正合你目前的处境，既有挑战也有回报。若你准备好为报酬而战，同盟也准备好雇用你的服务。

column1: Greetings, Commander. The Arc-Royal Liberty Coalition has a mission that aligns with your expertise and promises substantial reward. Success in this endeavor will not go unnoticed by our leadership
column2: 您好，指挥官。弧光自由同盟有一项与您的专长相符、且报酬丰厚的任务。此举若成，我们的领导层定会注意到。

column1: Commander, your esteemed reputation has reached us. The Coalition values such talent and compensates skill and loyalty generously. We invite you to join our efforts.
column2: 指挥官，您的美名已传至我们耳中。同盟看重这样的才干，对技艺与忠诚向来慷慨酬谢。我们邀请您加入我们的事业。

column1: Commander, I trust this message finds you well. The Arc-Royal Liberty Coalition has noted your exemplary service and believes this mission aligns with your expertise. We continue to offer competitive compensation for your skills.
column2: 指挥官，愿此信送达时您一切安好。弧光自由同盟已注意到您的卓越表现，并相信这项任务与您的专长相符。我们仍会为您的才干提供有竞争力的报酬。

column1: Esteemed ally, the Arc-Royal Liberty Coalition extends warm regards. We seek your valued services once more and assure you that your loyalty and expertise will be rewarded accordingly.
column2: 尊敬的盟友，弧光自由同盟向您致以诚挚问候。我们再次寻求您宝贵的效力，并向您保证，您的忠诚与专长将得到相称的回报。

column1: Success breeds strength, and today you have contributed meaningfully to the Coalition's enduring resilience. Excellent work, Commander. The Arc-Royal Liberty Coalition recognizes and values your efforts.
column2: 成功孕育力量，今日您为同盟持久的韧性作出了切实贡献。干得漂亮，指挥官。弧光自由同盟认可并珍视您的努力。

column1: In the Coalition, setbacks are opportunities to learn and rise stronger. While the mission did not succeed, your resolve and effort are noted, Commander. We trust you will regroup and return to prove your mettle.
column2: 在同盟，挫折是学习与变得更强的机会。任务虽未成功，但您的决心与努力我们看在眼里，指挥官。我们相信您会重整旗鼓，归来证明自己的胆识。

column1: Failure is an unacceptable outcome, but a lack of discipline is worse. Commander, your performance fell short of Coalition standards, undermining our trust. Reflect on this and ensure future actions demonstrate both competence and commitment.
column2: 失败是不可接受的结果，但缺乏纪律更糟。指挥官，您的表现未达同盟标准，动摇了我们的信任。请反思此事，确保今后的行动能同时体现能力与担当。

column1: I mourn our friendship of old, Commander. I don't know what led you away from us, but for the sake of our old allegiance, the Restoration offers you this contract. Please… come back to us.
column2: 我为昔日的友谊而哀悼，指挥官。我不知道是什么让你离开了我们，但看在旧日情谊的份上，复国军向你提供这份合约。求你……回到我们身边。

column1: I know you've already done so much for us, but we need your skills, Commander. With this, we gain a great advantage for the Restoration—and you gain a payday, like always.
column2: 我知道你已为我们做了太多，但我们需要你的本事，指挥官。接下这个，复国军便能占得大优势——而你也照例能拿到一笔进账。

column1: We've come a long way together, old friend, but I fear I have yet another favor to ask of you. Our fortunes are married together—aid us, and we will aid you, as it's always been. We would not ask this of a lesser ally.
column2: 我们一起走了很长的路，老朋友，但恐怕我又得请你帮个忙。我们的命运早已绑在一起——你助我们，我们便助你，一如既往。这种请求我们不会向次一等的盟友提出。

column1: You are a villain and a scoundrel, and you are unworthy of even the slightest consideration. Even so, our own forces are greatly weakened at this moment—so we're willing to entertain employing you.
column2: 你是个恶棍、无赖，连一丁点尊重都不配。即便如此，我方此刻兵力大损——所以我们才愿意考虑雇佣你。

column1: Our influence spreads, as do our garrisons. Your help has been invaluable in this, Commander—and we would like to offer you more work, providing you are not already overwhelmed. Let us know soon, please.
column2: 我们的影响力与驻军一同扩张。此事上你的帮助居功至伟，指挥官——我们想再提供些活儿给你，只要你别太忙不过来。请尽快告知。

column1: Good work, commander. You continue to impress me. House Espinosa - no, all Aurigan people - are in your debt.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。你一次次让我刮目相看。埃斯皮诺萨家族——不，全体奥里根人都欠你一份情。

column1: As much as the Axumite Providence is loath to deal with infidel, we have need of mercenaries, and you are here.
column2: 尽管阿克苏迈特天意国极不愿与异教徒打交道，但我们有用得上雇佣兵之处，而你恰好在此。

column1: The Axumite Providence has a contract that you may be competent enough to fulfill, insha'Allah.
column2: 阿克苏迈特天意国有一份合约，凭你的本事，但愿真主许可，足以胜任。

column1: Hello Commander.  We hope you can assist us in a small matter that requires a suitable mercenary force.
column2: 你好，指挥官。我们希望你能协助我们处理一桩小事，这需要一支合适的雇佣兵部队。

column1: Peace be unto you Commander.  We have heard you are a competent mercenary, and we would like present this contract for your consideration.
column2: 愿平安与你同在，指挥官。我们听说你是位能干事的雇佣兵，特此呈上这份合约供你考虑。

column1: Peace be unto you and so may the mercy of Allah and his blessings, friend of the Axumites.  You have served us well in the past, and we offer this contract in the hopes this relationship will continue to grow.
column2: 愿平安与你同在，愿真主的慈悯与福泽也与你同在，阿克苏迈特人的朋友。你过去一直为我们效力得很好，我们献上这份合约，期望这段关系能继续加深。

column1: Allah's blessings upon you, my friend.  We have need of your services once again, and in consideration of your past services to the Axumite Providence, we have a profitable contract for you today.
column2: 愿真主赐福于你，我的朋友。我们再次需要你的效力，念及你过去为阿克苏迈特天意国所作的贡献，今天我们有一份有利可图的合约给你。

column1: Allah bless you, and the Prophet Mohammad for guiding you back to us, my brother.  Once again we have a profitable contract for you, honoured friend, one we would entrust to no other.
column2: 愿真主赐福于你，也愿先知穆罕默德指引你回到我们身边，我的兄弟。我们再次为你备下一份有利可图的合约，尊敬的朋友，一份我们绝不托付他人的合约。

column1: Allah be praised, for it is by his will that you have completed this task for us.  Full payment has already been transferred to you for your services.
column2: 赞美真主，正是凭借他的意旨，你为我们完成了这项任务。你效力的全额报酬已经转入你的账户。

column1: It is unfortunate that you were unable to complete the task, however as Allah is merciful, so are we.  Perhaps we expected too much of you this time, and we hope you are able to perform better if we call upon you again.
column2: 你未能完成这项任务，实属遗憾，但真主慈悲，我们亦如此。或许这次是我们对你期望过高，若再度相召，我们希望你能表现得更出色。

column1: Infidel, I hope you do not expect payment for your pathetic performance.  Know that you have insulted the Axumite Providence with your cowardice.
column2: 异教徒，希望你别指望为你那可怜的表现索取报酬。你要知道，你的怯懦已经羞辱了阿克苏迈特天意国。

column1: In an earlier era, House Calderon would have had you killed rather than offer you a contract. Unfortunately, we don't live in that earlier era—and also, we need a disposable soldier. Accept or not; I don't care.
column2: 换作早年间，卡尔德隆家族会直接杀了你，而非向你提供合约。可惜我们不在那个年代——况且，我们需要一个用完即弃的兵。接不接随你，我不在乎。

column1: This contract may be of interest to you, Commander. The Calderon Protectorate believes it within your ability to complete, and in times like these, we are willing to pay you well to see it done. Please let us know.
column2: 这份合约或许会让你感兴趣，指挥官。卡尔德隆保护国相信你有力完成，而在这样的世道，我们愿意出重金把它办成。请告知我们。

column1: Hello, mercenary. The Calderon Protectorate values our relationship, and so we would like to offer you first right of refusal on this contract. The job is simple, and the pay adequate. We know it to be within your capabilities as well.
column2: 你好，雇佣兵。卡尔德隆保护国珍视我们的关系，因此想给你这份合约的优先拒绝权。活儿简单，报酬也过得去，我们也知道这在你的能力范围内。

column1: House Calderon would once again like to call upon you, our faithful janissary, ready to wage war in our name wherever we ask. Once more we ask you to join the fray on our behalf—and as always, we value your loyalty.
column2: 卡尔德隆家族再次相召，我们忠诚的禁卫军，随时准备听凭我们号令、以我们的名义开战。我们再一次请你代我们投身战阵——而一如既往，我们珍视你的忠诚。

column1: Commander, your constant desire to take up contracts against our poor nearly defenseless worlds is going to end up with the genocide of our society!  Please help us with this small task, and save our children from slavery.
column2: 指挥官，你总爱接下针对我们这些贫穷、几乎不设防的世界的合约，这终将导致我们整个社会的灭绝！请帮我们完成这桩小任务，把我们的孩子从奴役中救出来。

column1: Commander, the Nueva Castile are but a few small planets desperately wishing to remain independent.  Please stop fighting against us, and instead help us with this task.
column2: 指挥官，新卡斯蒂利亚不过是几颗拼命想要维持独立的小行星。请别再与我们为敌，转而帮我们完成这项任务吧。

column1: Commander, if you have been attacking the planets of Nueva Castile for money, we can offer you similar contracts that will preserve our independence, and I beg you to consider this one.
column2: 指挥官，若你攻打新卡斯蒂利亚的星球是为了钱，我们能提供报酬相当、又能保全我们独立的合约，恳请你考虑这一份。

column1: Welcome to Nueva Castile, Commander.  I have a task for you to undertake, if you would like to help preserve our independence.  You will of course be adequately compensated for your efforts.
column2: 欢迎来到新卡斯蒂利亚，指挥官。若你愿意帮助我们维持独立，我有一项任务交给你。你的付出自会得到充分的报酬。

column1: Thank you again for your help in protecting Nueva Castile's independence, Commander.  We would like to employ you once more to defend our sovereignty and independence, if you are able?
column2: 再次感谢你协助保护新卡斯蒂利亚的独立，指挥官。若你方便，我们想再度聘请你捍卫我们的主权与独立。

column1: Welcome friend of Nueva Castile.  You have helped us many times in the past, and hope you can take on this contract to assist us in preserving our independence once more.
column2: 欢迎你，新卡斯蒂利亚的朋友。你过去已多次相助，希望你接下这份合约，再度协助我们维持独立。

column1: A thousand blessings upon your head, Shield of Nueva Castile.  You have done so much for us I feel embarrassed to ask for your help again, however I assure you that you will be well paid for your efforts.
column2: 愿千般福泽加诸你身，新卡斯蒂利亚之盾。你为我们做得太多，我都不好意思再求你相助，但我向你保证，你的付出会得到丰厚报偿。

column1: Thank you Commander, we would be lost without you.  Payment for your help has already been transferred to your account.
column2: 谢谢你，指挥官，没有你我们早就完了。你应得的报酬已经转入你的账户。

column1: Commander, we appreciate all the help you can provide, but we are not wealthy enough to pay you in full for a partial completion of the contract.
column2: 指挥官，我们感激你能提供的所有帮助，但我们并不富裕，无法为一份只完成部分的合约支付全额报酬。

column1: Commander, the children of Nueva Castile are being enslaved as we speak due to your inability to complete this task.  Please don't harm our relationship further by seeking payment.
column2: 指挥官，正因为你无法完成这项任务，新卡斯蒂利亚的孩子们此刻正被卖为奴隶。请不要再索要报酬，进一步伤害我们的关系。

column1: Commander, you have already crushed our armed forces beneath the feet of your 'Mechs.  Please, if you want credits, we are quite capable of paying for you to fight for us instead of against!
column2: 指挥官，你已用机甲的脚步碾碎了我们的武装力量。求你，若你想要星币，我们完全付得起，让你为我们而战，而不是与我们为敌！

column1: Commander, we are unable to compete against your mighty 'Mechs.  Please, take on this contract and spare us further damage!
column2: 指挥官，我们无力与你那些强悍的机甲抗衡。求你接下这份合约，别再让我们遭受更多损失！

column1: Commander, you have proven we are no match for your 'Mechs.  Please help us to regain power in this area by taking up this task for us, and we will pay you well.
column2: 指挥官，你已证明我们斗不过你的机甲。请接下这项任务，帮我们夺回此地的控制权，我们会给你丰厚报酬。

column1: Commander, I hear you have 'Mechs in your dropship?  If so, we would like to contract you to undertake a task for us, one we will both find profit in.
column2: 指挥官，听说你的空投艇上有机甲？若有，我们想雇你为我们办一件事，一件你我都将获益的事。

column1: Commander, you have assisted us in the past, and I hope that we can come to an arrangement regarding another task we would like you to perform.
column2: 指挥官，你过去曾协助过我们，希望我们能为另一项想交托给你的任务达成安排。

column1: Hello again Commander.  Your 'Mechs are a force to be reckoned with, and we would like to contract you to perform another task for us.
column2: 又见面了，指挥官。你的机甲是一股不可小觑的力量，我们想雇你再为我们办一件事。

column1: Greetings my dear friend.  You and your 'Mechs have aided us so often in the past, when this highly profitable contract came up I saved it just for you.
column2: 你好，我亲爱的朋友。你和你的机甲过去已多次相助，所以当这份利润丰厚的合约出现时，我特意为你留着。

column1: Thank you Commander, you have crushed the enemy with your mighty 'Mechs.  Payment for your help has already been transferred to your account.
column2: 谢谢你，指挥官，你用强悍的机甲碾碎了敌人。你应得的报酬已经转入你的账户。

column1: Commander, we expected more from you seeing as you had a full lance of 'Mechs.  However, you did complete some of the tasks required, so I have transferred a partial payment.
column2: 指挥官，你有一整支机甲小队，我们本对你期望更高。不过你确实完成了部分要求，所以我转入了一笔部分报酬。

column1: Seriously Commander, my armies perform tasks like this all the time, with nothing but tanks and infantry; and you and your 'Mechs failed!  You must not have tried, and I won;t pay you anything!
column2: 说真的，指挥官，我的部队光靠坦克和步兵就经常完成这类任务；而你带着机甲却搞砸了！你肯定没尽力，我一个子儿都不会付你！

column1: Please Commander, we are but poor farmers trying to survive, and we suffer greatly because of your past actions.  We beg of you to undertake this small task against those who would oppress us.
column2: 求你了，指挥官，我们不过是挣扎求生的穷苦农夫，你过去的所作所为已让我们苦不堪言。我们恳求你接下这桩小任务，去对付那些想压迫我们的人。

column1: Commander, we can offer you contracts that match our rivals.  We beg you, please don't prey on us any more, but instead work with us by accepting this contract.
column2: 指挥官，我们能提供与我们的对手相当的合约。我们求你，别再以我们为猎物，而是接下这份合约，与我们合作。

column1: Commander, you have defeated us in combat before, so we know you are a competent mercenary unit.  Please take this contract on, and let us work together rather than against each other.
column2: 指挥官，你曾在战斗中击败过我们，所以我们知道你是支能打的雇佣兵部队。请接下这份合约，让我们携手合作，而非彼此为敌。

column1: The duly elected government of the Circinus Federation have a contract for a mercenary group of your calibre, if you are interested.
column2: 瑟西努斯联邦的民选政府有一份合约，提供给像你们这样水平的雇佣兵部队，若你们有兴趣的话。

column1: You fight well Commander, and we've both benefited from our relationship in the past.  I have another contract for you, which will benefit us both.
column2: 你打仗很在行，指挥官，我们双方过去都从这段关系中获益。我这还有一份合约给你，对你我都好。

column1: Ahoy Commander, it's good too see you again.  I've got another job for you, one where a good bit of loot, err I mean profit, can be had.
column2: 你好啊，指挥官，很高兴再见到你。我这又有一份活儿给你，能捞不少战利品，呃我是说利润。

column1: Ahoy Matey!  It's good to see you again, and I have a really juicy job for you with plenty of loot to be had!
column2: 嗨，伙计！很高兴再见到你，我这儿有份肥差给你，战利品多得是！

column1: Well done matey!  You finished off that contract easily, and your share of the loot, err, I mean payment, is already in your account.
column2: 干得好，伙计！你轻轻松松就了结了那份合约，你那份战利品，呃，我是说报酬，已经打进你账户了。

column1: You'd never make it in the Black Warriors with that sort of cowardly attitude!  I'll partially pay you this time, but complete the damn contract next time, or else!
column2: 就凭你这副怯懦的样子，在黑色战士里根本混不下去！这次我就付你一部分，但下次给我把该死的合约干完，否则有你好看！

column1: I should cut out your heart and feed it to my dog for failing... err, I mean you'll get no payment from us.
column2: 你搞砸了，我该挖出你的心喂狗……呃，我的意思是，你从我们这儿一个子儿也拿不到。

column1: I need not remind you that you have fought Clan Blood Spirit before, mercenary.  If you wish to begin to right the wrongs of the past, take this batchall before I assign it to a solahma unit.
column2: 雇佣兵，不必我提醒你，你曾与血魂氏族交过手。若你希望开始弥补过往的过错，趁我还没把这单交给索拉玛老兵单位之前，接下这份对战令吧。

column1: Mercenary, the Clan has faced you in battle before.  Take up this batchall and perhaps we can find a more common purpose.
column2: 雇佣兵，你的氏族过去与你交过战。接下这份对战令，或许我们能找到共同的目标。

column1: You have assisted Clan Blood Spirit in the past.  Continue to be useful by taking up this batchall and we might continue this relationship.
column2: 你过去曾协助过血魂氏族。继续展示你的用处，接下这份对战令，我们这段关系或许还能继续。

column1: Greetings, mercenary.  You have helped Clan Blood Spirit greatly, and in recognition of your service, I offer you this batchall I had reserved for our own warriors.
column2: 你好，雇佣兵。你曾大力帮助血魂氏族，为表彰你的功绩，我把这份原本为我们自己战士预留的对战令交给你。

column1: Your lack of honour is well known, so we offer this trivial task that is beneath even our solahma units, so you might begin to redeem yourself.
column2: 你缺乏荣誉的名声早已远扬，所以我们把这桩连索拉玛老兵单位都不屑一顾的琐碎任务交给你，好让你开始赎罪。

column1: You value money above honour.  This is not our way, but we have a task for you that will allow you to obtain the credits you so desperately seek.
column2: 你把金钱看得比荣誉更重。这不是我们的作风，但我们有一项任务能让你得到你渴求已久的星币。

column1: We have met in combat before, and you have proved yourself moderately competent.  Perhaps you would like to prove yourself against one of our foes?
column2: 我们曾在战斗中相遇，而你已证明自己尚算过得去。或许你想在我们的某个敌人面前再证明一次自己？

column1: You have served us well enough in the past, and we would like to continue this relationship.  Perhaps this batchall will be to your liking?
column2: 你过去为我们效力得还不错，我们希望延续这段关系。也许这份对战令正合你意？

column1: You fight with honour friend, and have shown yourself to be a capable warrior.  We have a task that we would normally not entrust to one such as you, but it is yours if you wish.
column2: 你带着荣誉而战，朋友，已证明自己是位能干的战士。我们有一项平时绝不会托付给你这种人的任务，但若你愿意，它就是你的了。

column1: I am glad to see you, friend of Clan Burrock.  In different times I might suggest you undergo The Blooding so that you might become one with us, but for now, I offer you this batchall as an equal.
column2: 很高兴见到你，伯洛克氏族的朋友。若是在别的时代，我或许会建议你接受血之洗礼、成为我们的一员，但眼下，我以平等之礼把这份对战令交给你。

column1: Well done Commander.  You have achieved your objectives as well as any Burrock Commander, and we have transferred your c-bills to your account.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。你完成目标的表现不亚于任何一位伯洛克指挥官，我们已把星币转入你的账户。

column1: Most Clans would simply kill you for your failure to honor your batchall, but I realise I ask too much of a mere mercenary.  Perhaps this partial payment will encourage you to do better next time.
column2: 多数氏族会因为你未能履行对战令而直接杀掉你，但我明白，对一名区区雇佣兵不能要求太高。也许这点部分报酬能鼓励你下次做得更好。

column1: Clearly the concept of honour is lost to you. If I had a Star available, I would kill you myself for your failure. I suggest you leave before one does become available.
column2: 显而易见，荣誉这个概念对你已经荡然无存。若我手里有一支星队可用，我早就亲手为你的失败取你性命。我建议你趁我手上还没有星队前赶快离开。

column1: Heathen, you lack both faith and honour, however we have a task that is beneath even our solahma units that you might bid on if you wish to redeem yourself.
column2: 异教徒，你既缺乏信仰也毫无荣誉。不过我们有一桩甚至连索拉玛老兵单位都不屑一顾的任务，若你想赎罪，可以来竞价。

column1: Heathen, we know you only worship money as the Dark Caste do.  This is not The Way, but we have a task for you that will allow you to obtain the credits you so desperately seek.
column2: 异教徒，我们知道你只会像黑暗种姓一样膜拜金钱。这不是正道，但我们有一项任务，能让你得到你拼命想弄到手的星币。

column1: We have met in combat before, and you have proven yourself moderately competent, if faithless.  Return to The Way, and take up this batchall against our foes
column2: 我们曾在战斗中相遇，你已证明自己尚算过得去，只是缺乏信仰。回到正道上来，接下这份针对我们敌人的对战令。

column1: We have seen that you respect The Way, and we would like to continue this relationship.  Perhaps this batchall will be to your liking?
column2: 我们看到你尊重正道，也希望延续这段关系。也许这份对战令正合你意？

column1: You do God's work, and have shown yourself to be a capable warrior.  We have a task that we would normally not entrust to one such as you, but it is yours if you wish.
column2: 你在为神行事，已证明自己是位能干的战士。我们有一项平时绝不会托付给你这种人的任务，但若你愿意，它就是你的了。

column1: The Way has brought you back to us, dear friend.  In different times I might suggest you undergo The Blooding so that you might become one with us, but for now, I offer you this batchall as an equal.
column2: 正道把你带回了我们身边，亲爱的朋友。若是在别的时代，我或许会建议你接受血之洗礼、成为我们的一员，但眼下，我以平等之礼把这份对战令交给你。

column1: Well done Commander.  You have achieved your objectives as well as any Warrior-Priest, and we have transferred your c-bills to your account.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。你完成目标的表现不亚于任何一位战士祭司，我们已把星币转入你的账户。

column1: The Way teaches us that we should not expect others to be as proficient in battle as we are.  Take this partial payment, and pray to God that you might perform better next time.
column2: 正道教导我们，不应指望他人像我们一样精通战斗。收下这份部分报酬，向上帝祈祷，愿你来日表现更佳。

column1: You have failed.  You do not follow The Way, you have no honour, and God has averted his eyes from you.  I suggest you meditate on your failures and pray for forgiveness before you contact us again.
column2: 你失败了。你不遵从正道，毫无荣誉，上帝也已移开目光。我建议你在再次联系我们之前，静思己过并祈求宽恕。

column1: You seek only money and have no morality.  If all are like you, then perhaps our spirit guides were wrong to ask us to protect those Kerensky left behind.  Take this batchall, and show us that you treasure the gifts of your ancestors.
column2: 你只追求金钱，毫无道德。若人人都像你一样，或许我们的精神向导当初就不该叫我们去保护克伦斯基留下的人们。接下这份对战令，向我们证明你还珍视祖先的馈赠。

column1: The spirits of the Coyote Clan are displeased with you.  Take up this batchall if you do not wish to anger us further.
column2: 郊狼氏族的神灵对你很不满。若你不想进一步惹怒我们，就接下这份对战令。

column1: We have met in combat before, and you have proved yourself moderately competent.  The Coyote Clan offers you this batchall to appease the spirits of those who have fallen, and to improve our relationship.
column2: 我们曾在战斗中相遇，你已证明自己尚算过得去。郊狼氏族以这份对战令向你致意，以安抚逝者之灵，并改善我们的关系。

column1: The Coyote recognizes your assistance and your strength, and we would like to continue this relationship.  Perhaps this batchall will be to your liking?
column2: 郊狼认可你的帮助与力量，我们愿延续这段关系。也许这份对战令正合你意？

column1: You have proven yourself a valuable servant to the Coyote Clan.  We have a task that we would normally not entrust to one such as you, but it is yours if you wish.
column2: 你已证明自己是郊狼氏族宝贵的仆从。我们有一项平时绝不会托付给你这种人的任务，但若你愿意，它就是你的了。

column1: The Coyote hunts with you, and you have served us as well as any mercenary could be expected to.  As a symbol of our trust in you, I offer you this batchall as an equal.
column2: 郊狼与你并肩狩猎，你为我们效力的表现不亚于任何雇佣兵所能期望的。作为信任你的象征，我以平等之礼把这份对战令交给你。

column1: Well done Commander.  You have achieved your objectives as well as any of my pack, and we have transferred your c-bills to your account.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。你完成目标的表现不亚于我的任何一位族人，我们已把星币转入你的账户。

column1: The Coyote Clan expects more from those who serve it, however we should not have expected you to be able to hunt as we do.  Take this partial payment, and may the spirit of the Coyote help you to perform better next time.
column2: 郊狼氏族对服侍它的人期望更高，不过我们本就不该指望你能像我们这样狩猎。收下这份部分报酬，愿郊狼之灵助你来日表现更佳。

column1: You have failed, and have proven even our sibko can hunt better than a mercenary.  You will receive nothing from us save our scorn and disgust.
column2: 你失败了，连我们的幼狮都证明比你更会狩猎。你从我们这里得到的只有轻蔑与厌恶。

column1: You have constantly been a thorn in the side of Clan Diamond Shark's desire for mutually profitable trade.  However, if you desire C-Bills so badly, perhaps we could allow you to take up this minor task.
column2: 你一直如芒刺在背，妨碍着钻石鲨氏族互利贸易的愿望。不过，若你真那么想要星币，或许我们能让你接下这桩小任务。

column1: The basic premise of trade requires at least a modest level of trust.  So far, you have done little to engender that trust; perhaps this batchall will reverse this.
column2: 贸易的基本前提至少需要适度的信任。到目前为止，你几乎没做任何事来赢得这份信任；也许这份对战令能扭转局面。

column1: We have met in combat before, and you have proved yourself a moderately competent warrior, if somewhat blind to the concept of mutual profit.  We have a batchall for you that would allow us to move towards a better relationship.
column2: 我们曾在战斗中相遇，你已证明自己是位尚算过得去的战士，只是对互惠互利的概念有些迟钝。我们有份对战令，能让我们走向更好的关系。

column1: We have both profited from our dealings in the past, let us continue this with this batchall.
column2: 我们过去都在交易中获益，就让我们凭这份对战令继续下去吧。

column1: Hello again, friend to the Diamond Sharks.  We offer you this choice batchall in recognition of our friendship, and mutual profitability.
column2: 又见面了，钻石鲨的朋友。为纪念我们的友谊与互利，我们向你献上这份精选对战令。

column1: Greetings my trusted friend.  We have both benefited greatly from our association, and I offer this batchall to you as I would a fellow Warrior-Trader, in the spirit of our brotherhood.
column2: 你好，我信赖的朋友。我们的交往令双方受益良多，我以兄弟情谊，像对待同为战士商人的同胞一样，把这份对战令交给你。

column1: Well done Commander.  The satisfactory completion of this batchall will benefit us greatly, and we have transferred your c-bills to your account.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。这份对战令的圆满完成将让我们大受裨益，我们已把星币转入你的账户。

column1: You are aware that successful trade requires both sides to honour the terms of the batchall?  We are disappointed that you could not complete the objectives, however we offer this partial payment for your partial completion.
column2: 你应当明白，成功的贸易要求双方都履行对战令的条款吧？你未能完成目标，我们很失望，但我们仍为你的部分完成支付部分报酬。

column1: You have failed to honour the terms of the batchall in any significant way.  You receive nothing from us, and know that your failure will affect our trade relationship in future.
column2: 你未能以任何有意义的方式履行对战令的条款。你从我们这里一无所获，要知道，你的失败会影响我们将来的贸易关系。

column1: Tou have been very consistent in your hatred of the Fire Mandrill Clan.  If my own kindraa were available I would use them for this task, but as they are occupied with more worthy opponents, you can take this batchall, or not.
column2: 你一直持之以恒地仇视火猩猩氏族。若我的亲族有空，我会让他们来做这活，但他们正忙于更有价值的对手，所以这份对战令你爱接不接。

column1: My kindraa have faced you in battle before, and several lie dead by your hand.  Perhaps you can spill another's blood for a change with this batchall?
column2: 我的亲族曾与你交战，其中数人死于你手。或许你可以凭这份对战令，转而流血于他人身上？

column1: I have heard from other kindraa you have battled before that you are a competent warrior.  Perhaps you can assist me in this small task?
column2: 我从其他与你交过战的亲族那里听说，你是位能干的战士。也许你能帮我做这桩小事？

column1: You have assisted other kindraa of the Fire Mandrill in the past, and I would like to offer you this batchall so that you can assist my kindraa as well.
column2: 你过去曾协助过火猩猩的其他亲族，我想向你提供这份对战令，好让你也帮帮我这一支。

column1: Hello again, friend to the Fire Mandrills.  We offer you this choice batchall in recognition of our friendship.
column2: 又见面了，火猩猩的朋友。为纪念我们的友谊，我们向你献上这份精选对战令。

column1: Greetings my trusted friend.  You have helped me so often, I almost look at you as a member of my own kindraa.  I have this choice batchall for you, if you are interested?
column2: 你好，我信赖的朋友。你帮我太多次，我几乎把你当作自己的亲族。我这里有份精选对战令，不知你是否感兴趣？

column1: Well done Commander.  The satisfactory completion of this batchall will benefit my kindraa, and I have transferred your c-bills to your account.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。这份对战令的圆满完成将惠及我的亲族，我们已把星币转入你的账户。

column1: You are aware that a batchall requires completion of all the objectives?   However I will provide a partial payment for your partial completion, so long as you do better next time.
column2: 你应当明白，对战令要求完成所有目标吧？不过，只要你下次表现更好，我仍会为你的部分完成支付部分报酬。

column1: You have failed to honour the terms of the batchall in any significant way.  You receive nothing from me, and have insulted my kindraa.
column2: 你未能以任何有意义的方式履行对战令的条款。你从我这里一无所获，而且还羞辱了我的亲族。

column1: Your insistence on opposing the Bear has not gone unnoticed.  There is still time to avoid your destruction.  You can begin to make amends with this batchall.
column2: 你执意与熊为敌，这事我们不会视而不见。要避免覆灭，现在还有时间。你可以从接下这份对战令开始弥补。

column1: Your craving for battle is well known.  Perhaps this batchall will satiate your desire?
column2: 你渴望战斗的名声早已远扬。也许这份对战令能让你大饱一战之欲？

column1: My Clan has faced you in battle before, and you are a competent warrior.  Take up this batchall and perhaps we can find a more common purpose.
column2: 我的氏族曾在战斗中与你相遇，你也是位能干的战士。接下这份对战令，或许我们能找到共同的目标。

column1: You have assisted the Ghost Bear clan in the past, and I would like to offer you this batchall so that we can continue this relationship.
column2: 你过去曾协助过幽灵熊氏族，我想向你提供这份对战令，好让我们的关系继续下去。

column1: Hello again, friend to the Ghost Bears.  We offer you this batchall in recognition of our kinship.
column2: 又见面了，幽灵熊的朋友。为纪念我们的亲缘，我们向你献上这份对战令。

column1: Greetings my brother.  You have helped me so often, I almost look at you as a member of my own family.  I have this choice batchall for you, if you are interested?
column2: 你好，我的兄弟。你帮我太多次，我几乎把你当作自己的家人。我这里有份精选对战令，不知你是否感兴趣？

column1: Well done Commander.  The satisfactory completion of this batchall will benefit the Ghost Bears, and I have transferred your c-bills as agreed.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。这份对战令的圆满完成将惠及幽灵熊，我们已按约定把星币转入你的账户。

column1: You clearly lacked the strength to complete all the objectives?   However I will provide a partial payment for your partial completion, so long as you do better next time.
column2: 你显然缺乏完成所有目标的力量吧？不过，只要你下次表现更好，我仍会为你的部分完成支付部分报酬。

column1: Your weakness is an embarrassment, and you have failed to honour the terms of the batchall in any significant way.  You receive nothing from me, other than my disdain.
column2: 你的软弱令人难堪，你未能以任何有意义的方式履行对战令的条款。你从我这里一无所获，只得到我的鄙夷。

column1: If it were not for the fact that the necrosia has showed me you can be of service, I would not suffer your presence.  Here is a trivial task for you, to prove your worth.
column2: 若不是因为死后迷幻药让我看到你还能有些用处，我根本不会容忍你出现在我面前。这桩琐事拿去，证明你的价值吧。

column1: Your dishonorable ways are well known to Clan Goliath Scorpion, however you might be of service.  Take this batchall, and show me that you can be of service.
column2: 你的无耻行径在巨人蝎氏族早已尽人皆知，不过你或许还有点用处。接下这份对战令，向我证明你的价值。

column1: You have assisted Clan Goliath Scorpion in the past, and I would like to offer you this batchall so that we can continue this relationship.
column2: 你过去曾协助过巨人蝎氏族，我想向你提供这份对战令，好让我们的关系继续下去。

column1: Hello again, friend to Clan Goliath Scorpion.  While there is certainly trust between us, I would like you to take this batchall to show your sincerity before we share all our secrets with you.
column2: 又见面了，巨人蝎氏族的朋友。我们之间确有信任，但在与你分享我们的全部秘密之前，我希望你先接下这份对战令以示诚意。

column1: Greetings friend.  You have proven your value to the Goliath Scorpions many times.  I have a task I would entrust to no other, and perhaps afterwards we shall share some necrosa?
column2: 你好，朋友。你已多次向巨人蝎证明自己的价值。我有一件只愿托付给你的任务，也许完成后我们会共饮些死后迷幻药？

column1: Well done Commander.  I foresaw your success in this matter, and have already transferred your c-bills as agreed.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。我早已预见你此事能成，并已按约定把星币转入你的账户。

column1: You clearly lacked the strength to complete all the objectives, however your attempt was noted. I will provide a partial payment for your partial completion, so long as you do better next time.
column2: 你显然缺乏完成所有目标的力量，不过你的尝试我们记下了。只要你下次表现更好，我仍会为你的部分完成支付部分报酬。

column1: Your repeated actions against Hell's Horses have made me question whether I should hold you in disdain.  Take up this batchall and prove to me that mercenaries such as you are useful.
column2: 你三番两次与地狱马为敌，让我怀疑是不是该对你报以轻蔑。接下这份对战令，向我证明你这样的雇佣兵还有用处。

column1: You have fought against Hell's Horses on many occasions.  Prove you can assist as well as cause harm by performing this task, and we might have further use for you.
column2: 你曾多次与地狱马交战。完成这项任务，证明你既能造成伤害，也能提供帮助，或许我们日后还用得上你。

column1: You have assisted the Hell's Horses in the past, and I would like to offer you this batchall so that we can continue this relationship.
column2: 你过去曾协助过地狱马，我想向你提供这份对战令，好让我们的关系继续下去。

column1: Hello again, friend to the Hell's Horses Clan.  We offer you this batchall in recognition of our friendship, and in the hopes that we can benefit each other in future.
column2: 又见面了，地狱马氏族的朋友。为纪念我们的友谊，并期望日后彼此受益，我们向你献上这份对战令。

column1: Greetings, my friend.  You have helped me so often, I feel we should discuss the possibility of you joining the Horses yourself.  Before we do however, there is a task I would entrust to no other that you might assist us with.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。你帮了我太多，我觉得我们该谈谈你亲自加入马族的可能。不过在谈之前，有一件我只愿托付给你的任务想请你相助。

column1: While Hell's Horses value swiftness, we don't value those who run from battle!  However I will provide a partial payment for your partial completion, so long as you do better next time.
column2: 地狱马看重迅捷，可我们并不看重临阵脱逃之人！不过，只要你下次表现更好，我仍会为你的部分完成支付部分报酬。

column1: Your cowardice dishonors you, and you have failed to honour the terms of the batchall in any significant way.  You receive nothing from me, other than my disdain.
column2: 你的怯懦使你蒙羞，你未能以任何有意义的方式履行对战令的条款。你从我这里一无所获，只得到我的鄙夷。

column1: Sadly I don't have Hellions nearby for this trivial batchall, so I am forced to rely on scum like you.  Take this task, or I will find another.
column2: 可惜我手边没有地狱火骑士可派来做这桩琐碎的差事，所以只能指望你这样的渣滓。接下这任务，否则我另找他人。

column1: Your presence offends me as you have fought against the Ice Hellions on many occasions.  If I had a solahama unit available, I would call upon them for this task, but as they are busy, take this batchall if you wish.
column2: 你多次与冰狱火交战，你的存在令我不悦。若我有一支索拉玛老兵单位可用，我定会派他们去做这事，但他们正忙，所以这份对战令随你接不接。

column1: The Ice Hellions have faced you in battle before, and you are a competent warrior.  Take up this batchall and perhaps we can find a more common purpose.
column2: 冰狱火曾在战斗中与你相遇，你也是位能干的战士。接下这份对战令，或许我们能找到共同的目标。

column1: You have assisted the Ice Hellions in the past.  Continue to be useful by taking up this batchall and we might continue this relationship.
column2: 你过去曾协助过冰狱火。继续展现你的用处，接下这份对战令，我们的关系或许还能继续。

column1: I must admit I am surprised you have been so useful to the Ice Hellions.  We offer you this batchall in recognition of your service.
column2: 我必须承认，你居然对冰狱火如此有用，这让我颇感意外。为表彰你的功绩，我们向你献上这份对战令。

column1: Greetings, my friend.  You have helped me so often, I am beginning to change my views on those of the Inner Sphere.  I have this choice task for you that should benefit us both greatly.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。你帮了我太多次，我已开始改变对内天体之人的看法。我有一件精选任务，应该能令我们双方大受裨益。

column1: Your cowardice is as much as I expect from a mercenary, for you have failed to honour the terms of the batchall in any significant way.  One day the Ice Hellions will strike you down for this.
column2: 你的怯懦与我对雇佣兵的预期毫无二致，因为你未能以任何有意义的方式履行对战令的条款。有朝一日，冰狱火会为此将你击倒。

column1: I normally don't look down on Freeborn such as you, but your repeated actions against Clan Mongoose have made me question whether I should hold you all in disdain.  Take up this batchall and prove to me that Freeborn such as you are useful.
column2: 我通常不会看不起你这样的自由民，但你对猫鼬氏族的一再敌对，让我怀疑是否该对你们全体抱以轻蔑。接下这份对战令，向我证明你这样的自由民还有用处。

column1: Freeborn, you have fought against Clan Mongoose on many occasions.  Prove you can assist as well as cause harm by performing this task, and we might have further use for you.
column2: 自由民，你曾多次与猫鼬氏族交战。完成这项任务，证明你既能造成伤害，也能提供帮助，或许我们日后还用得上你。

column1: Freeborn, my Clan has faced you in battle before, and you are an aggressive warrior.  Take up this batchall and perhaps we can find a more common purpose.
column2: 自由民，我的氏族曾在战斗中与你相遇，你也是位好战的战士。接下这份对战令，或许我们能找到共同的目标。

column1: Freeborn, you have assisted the Mongooses in the past, and I would like to offer you this batchall so that we can continue this relationship.
column2: 自由民，你过去曾协助过猫鼬各支，我想向你提供这份对战令，好让我们的关系继续下去。

column1: Hello again, friend to Clan Mongoose.  We offer you this batchall in recognition of our friendship, and in the hopes that we can benefit each other in future.
column2: 又见面了，猫鼬氏族的朋友。为纪念我们的友谊，并期望日后彼此受益，我们向你献上这份对战令。

column1: Greetings my friend.  You have helped me so often, I feel we should discuss the possibility of you joining Clan Mongoose yourself.  Before we do however, there is a task I would entrust to no other that you might assist us with.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。你帮了我太多，我觉得我们该谈谈你亲自加入猫鼬氏族的可能。不过在谈之前，有一件我只愿托付给你的任务想请你相助。

column1: Well done Commander.  Your tenacity in completing this batchall will benefit us both, and I have transferred your c-bills as agreed.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。你圆满完成这份对战令的坚韧将让我们双双受益，我已按约定把星币转入你的账户。

column1: Clan Mongoose prefers more aggressive commanders.  You've made a valiant, yet ineffective effort. We trust you will show more ferocity for the next battle.
column2: 猫鼬氏族更喜欢具攻击性的指挥官。你已付出了英勇却收效甚微的努力。我们相信下一场战斗你会展现更多凶猛。

column1: Your performance was appalling, Commander. You should consider a career as a merchant.
column2: 你的表现令人震惊，指挥官。你不如考虑改行当商人。

column1: You seek only money and have no higher spiritual calling.  As much as it goes against the visions of our Oathmaster, I find myself in need of assistance in a minor task, and offer you this batchall.
column2: 你只追求金钱，没有更高的精神召唤。尽管这与我们誓约大师的愿景相悖，但我发现自己确实需要人协助一桩小事，所以奉上这份对战令。

column1: Your actions go against destiny, and if you continue you will be crushed.  Take up this batchall and return to the right side of the path pre-ordained for us, before it is too late.
column2: 你的行为违背命运，若继续下去，你将被碾碎。趁为时未晚，接下这份对战令，回到为我们预定的道路上来。

column1: We have met in combat before, and you have proved yourself moderately competent.  The Nova Cats offer you this batchall to improve our relationship.
column2: 我们曾在战斗中相遇，你已证明自己尚算过得去。新猫族以此对战令向你致意，以改善我们的关系。

column1: The Nova Cats recognize your assistance and your strength, and we would like to continue this relationship.  Perhaps this batchall will be to your liking?
column2: 新猫族认可你的帮助与力量，我们愿延续这段关系。也许这份对战令正合你意？

column1: You have proven yourself a valuable servant to the Nova Cats.  We have a task that we would normally not entrust to one such as you, but it is yours if you wish.
column2: 你已证明自己是新猫族宝贵的仆从。我们有一项平时绝不会托付给你这种人的任务，但若你愿意，它就是你的了。

column1: The Nova Cats appreciate your assistance, and you have served us as well as any mercenary could be expected to.  As a symbol of our trust in you, I offer you this batchall as an equal.
column2: 新猫族感谢你的协助，你为我们效力的表现不亚于任何雇佣兵所能期望的。作为信任你的象征，我以平等之礼把这份对战令交给你。

column1: Well done Commander.  You have achieved your objectives as well as could be expected, and we have transferred the agreed c-bills to your account.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。你完成目标的表现已属可圈可点，我们已把约定好的星币转入你的账户。

column1: The Oathmaster was right to warn us against the use of mercenaries.  Take this partial payment, for your partial success, and do better next time if you wish to serve us.
column2: 誓约大师警告我们别用雇佣兵，果然没错。收下这份部分报酬，换取你的部分成功，若你还想为我们效力，下次就做得更好。

column1: You have failed, and have proven that such as you are weak and useless.  You will receive nothing from us save our scorn and disgust.
column2: 你失败了，也证明了你这种人既软弱又无用。你从我们这里得到的只有轻蔑与厌恶。

column1: {COMPANY.CompanyName} has no current standing with the Clan Protectorate. While your external reputation is noted, we will assess your capabilities firsthand to determine alignment with our operational standards.
column2: {COMPANY.CompanyName}目前在氏族保护国尚无地位。虽然我们注意到你们在外界的名声，但我们会亲自评估你们的能力，以判断是否符合我们的作战标准。

column1: {COMPANY.CompanyName}, your adherence to our directives and operational conduct meet our expectations, which warrants consideration for future assignments.
column2: {COMPANY.CompanyName}，你们对我们指令的遵从与作战操守达到了我们的期望，值得我们考虑未来的任务。

column1: Having engaged {COMPANY.CompanyName} for several missions, we have observed consistent performance and reliability from you. Your integration with our forces has been smooth, contributing positively to our objectives.
column2: {COMPANY.CompanyName}已承接我们的多项任务，我们从中观察到你们一贯的表现与可靠。你们与我军的整合十分顺畅，为我们的目标作出了积极贡献。

column1: {COMPANY.CompanyName} have proven to be a reliable partner, executing missions that have significantly advanced our strategic interests. Your professionalism and tactical acumen are commendable.
column2: {COMPANY.CompanyName}已证明是可靠的伙伴，执行的任务大幅推进了我们的战略利益。你们的专业素养与战术头脑值得称赞。

column1: Through numerous successful operations, {COMPANY.CompanyName} is a trusted ally. Your exemplary service and commitment to our goals have reinforced our mutual respect and collaboration.
column2: 经过多次成功行动，{COMPANY.CompanyName}已是可信赖的盟友。你们堪称表率的服务与对我们目标的投入，加深了我们彼此的尊重与合作。

column1: {COMPANY.CompanyName} stands out as a preferred mercenary unit for the Clan Protectorate. Your distinguished record and unwavering dedication have been instrumental in achieving our mission-critical objectives.
column2: {COMPANY.CompanyName}是氏族保护国首选的雇佣兵部队。你们卓越的履历与坚定不移的投入，对实现我们至关重要的目标起到了关键作用。

column1: {COMPANY.CompanyName} is our premier choice for mercenary engagements. Your unmatched excellence, strategic insight, and flawless execution have set a benchmark, making your company indispensable to the Clan Protectorate's endeavors.
column2: {COMPANY.CompanyName}是我们雇佣兵合作的首要之选。你们无与伦比的卓越、战略洞察与完美执行树立了标杆，使你们成为氏族保护国事业不可或缺的力量。

column1: Commander, {COMPANY.CompanyName} has fulfilled its mission with precision and efficiency. The Clan Protectorate appreciates your dedication and professionalism, and this success strengthens our confidence in your team's capabilities.
column2: 指挥官，{COMPANY.CompanyName}以精确和高效完成了任务。氏族保护国感谢你们的投入与专业素养，此次成功更增强了我们对贵团队能力的信心。

column1: Commander, while the mission did not meet its primary objectives, your team's commitment and efforts are recognized. External factors complicated the operation, and we believe this setback does not reflect a lack of resolve on your part.
column2: 指挥官，任务虽未达成主要目标，但贵团队的担当与努力我们看在眼里。外部因素令行动变得复杂，我们相信此次挫折并不代表你们缺乏决心。

column1: Commander, the outcome of this mission is unacceptable. Failures stemming from inadequate execution or disregard for Protectorate standards undermine our trust. Future assignments will require clear accountability and significant improvement from your team.
column2: 指挥官，此次任务的结果不可接受。因执行不力或无视保护国标准而造成的失败，动摇了我们的信任。未来的任务需要贵团队明确负责，并作出重大改进。

column1: I normally don't look down on Freeborn such as you, but your repeated actions against Clan Sea Fox have made me question whether I should hold you all in disdain.  Take up this batchall and prove to me that Freeborn such as you are useful.
column2: 我通常不会看不起你这样的自由民，但你对海狐氏族的一再敌对，让我怀疑是否该对你们全体抱以轻蔑。接下这份对战令，向我证明你这样的自由民还有用处。

column1: Freeborn, you have fought against Clan Sea Fox on many occasions.  Prove you can assist as well as cause harm by performing this task, and we might have further use for you.
column2: 自由民，你曾多次与海狐氏族交战。完成这项任务，证明你既能造成伤害，也能提供帮助，或许我们日后还用得上你。

column1: Freeborn, you have assisted the Sea Foxs in the past, and I would like to offer you this batchall so that we can continue this relationship.
column2: 自由民，你过去曾协助过海狐各支，我想向你提供这份对战令，好让我们的关系继续下去。

column1: Hello again, friend to Clan Sea Fox.  We offer you this batchall in recognition of our friendship, and in the hopes that we can benefit each other in future.
column2: 又见面了，海狐氏族的朋友。为纪念我们的友谊，并期望日后彼此受益，我们向你献上这份对战令。

column1: Greetings my friend.  You have helped me so often, I feel we should discuss the possibility of you joining Clan Sea Fox yourself.  Before we do however, there is a task I would entrust to no other that you might assist us with.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。你帮了我太多，我觉得我们该谈谈你亲自加入海狐氏族的可能。不过在谈之前，有一件我只愿托付给你的任务想请你相助。

column1: Well done Commander.  Your efficiency in completing this batchall will benefit us both, and I have transferred your c-bills as agreed.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。你高效完成这份对战令将让我们双双受益，我已按约定把星币转入你的账户。

column1: Clan Sea Fox prefers more tactical commanders.  You've made a valiant, yet ineffective effort. We trust you will commit better assets for the next battle.
column2: 海狐氏族更喜欢讲究战术的指挥官。你已付出了英勇却收效甚微的努力。我们相信下一场战斗你会投入更好的力量。

column1: Your performance reeks, nearly as much as you do, Commander. We suggest you bathe before coming before us again.
column2: 你的表现臭气熏天，几乎和你本人一样，指挥官。建议你下次来见我们之前先洗个澡。

column1: Freeborn, you have assisted the Sea Foxes in the past, and I would like to offer you this batchall so that we can continue this relationship.
column2: 自由民，你过去曾协助过海狐，我想向你提供这份对战令，好让我们的关系继续下去。

column1: Mercenary, we understand that you have found fighting against the Clans profitable in the past, and would like to change your thoughts with this batchall.
column2: 雇佣兵，我们知道你过去觉得与氏族为敌有利可图，想用这份对战令改变你的想法。

column1: Mercenary, you have fought well against the Clans in the past.  We would like to employ your skills in a task that furthers the Clans goals, and so we offer you this batchall.
column2: 雇佣兵，你过去与氏族交战表现出色。我们想借重你的本事完成一项推进氏族目标的任务，特此奉上这份对战令。

column1: Commander, the Clans have faced you in battle before, and you have proven yourself competent.  Take up this batchall and let us work together in a mutually beneficial way.
column2: 指挥官，氏族曾在战斗中与你相遇，你已证明自己能力出众。接下这份对战令，让我们以互利的方式携手合作。

column1: Commander, you have assisted the the Clans adequately in the past.  Before we take this relationship further, we need you to perform a task for the Clans.
column2: 指挥官，你过去曾充分协助过氏族。在将这段关系推进一步之前，我们需要你为氏族完成一项任务。

column1: Commander, you have served us admirably in the past.  I offer you this batchall knowing you will perform as well as any of our commanders.
column2: 指挥官，你过去为我们效力得令人钦佩。我奉上这份对战令，深知你会表现得像我们的任何一位指挥官一样出色。

column1: Commander, the Clans regard you as one of their own. I have kept this task for you, and would trust no one else to succeed.
column2: 指挥官，氏族视你为自己人。我为你留着这项任务，不放心交给任何其他人来做。

column1: Well done Commander. Know that the Clans recognize your service, and I have transferred the agreed payment to your account.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。要知道氏族认可你的功绩，我已把约定好的报酬转入你的账户。

column1: We expect all tasks assigned to be completed, mercenary. However, we recognize your attempt, and provide a partial payment for your partial completion of the tasks.
column2: 雇佣兵，我们期望交给你的所有任务都得到完成。不过我们认可你的尝试，为你的部分完成支付部分报酬。

column1: You have failed, and this failure sets back our plans.  Do not expect payment, as none will be provided.
column2: 你失败了，这次失败拖累了我们的计划。别指望报酬，一分也不会有。

column1: I come to you seeking to reverse the distrust between us, by offering you this batchall.  I hope you will accept it.
column2: 我来找你，是想借这份对战令化解我们之间的猜忌。希望你能接受。

column1: I wish this emnity between us to go away so that we can offer you more exclusive batchalls.  Please take this so that we can move towards a more trusting relationship.
column2: 我希望我们之间的敌意就此消散，好让我们能向你提供更专属的对战令。请接下这个，好让我们朝更互信的关系迈进。

column1: Clan Snow Raven has faced you in battle before.  Take up this batchall so we can mutually profit from a closer relationship.
column2: 雪鸦氏族曾在战斗中与你相遇。接下这份对战令，好让我们从更紧密的关系中互利。

column1: You have assisted Clan Snow Raven in the past.  Continue to be useful by taking up this batchall and we will offer you more profitable tasks.
column2: 你过去曾协助过雪鸦氏族。继续展现你的用处，接下这份对战令，我们会向你提供更有利可图的任务。

column1: Hello again, my friend.  I have saved this batchall especially for you, in recognition of your fine service in the past.
column2: 又见面了，我的朋友。念及你过去出色的功绩，我特意为你留着这份对战令。

column1: It is good to see you, my friend.  I have a particularly profitable batchall for you this time, one I can give to no other.
column2: 很高兴见到你，我的朋友。这次我有份特别有利可图的对战令给你，一份我不会交给任何其他人的任务。

column1: As expected, you have performed the tasks required admirably.  I have transferred the C-bills into your account and hope to work with you again.
column2: 不出所料，你出色地完成了所要求的任务。我已把星币转入你的账户，期待再次与你合作。

column1: It is such a shame that you couldn't complete the tasks assigned to you.  Sadly, I can only offer you a partial payment for those tasks you did accomplish - strictly business, nothing personal.
column2: 你未能完成交办的任务，真是遗憾。可惜我只能为你确实完成的部分支付部分报酬——纯属生意，与私人恩怨无关。

column1: You can't expect to enter into a batchall and then fail to fulfill any of it's conditions!  You will need to try much harder if you wish to have any further dealings with the Clan.
column2: 你总不能接下对战令后一项条款都不履行吧！若你还想与我们氏族继续往来，就得加倍努力。

column1: Mercenary commander, your actions against Clan Star Adder has gone against our strategic plans numerous times in the past.  Let us reverse this trend by you taking up this batchall.
column2: 雇佣兵指挥官，你过去多次针对星蝰氏族的行动违背了我们的战略计划。接下这份对战令，让我们扭转这一局面。

column1: Commander, you have fought well against us in the past.  Perhaps you can work with us towards our strategic goals instead, by taking up this batchall?
column2: 指挥官，你过去与我们交战表现出色。或许你可以接下这份对战令，转而与我们一同推进战略目标？

column1: Clan Star Adder have faced you in battle before, and you are a competent warrior.  Let us work together instead, take up this batchall and we can both benefit.
column2: 星蝰氏族曾在战斗中与你相遇，你也是位能干的战士。不如让我们携手合作，接下这份对战令，双方都能获益。

column1: You have assisted the Clan adequately in the past.  Let us continue this partnership, by you performing this task towards our long term strategic goals.
column2: 你过去曾充分协助过本氏族。让我们继续这段合作，由你完成这项推进我们长期战略目标的任务。

column1: Commander, you have served us admirably in the past.  I offer you this batchall knowing you will perform as well as any of our trueborn commanders.
column2: 指挥官，你过去为我们效力得令人钦佩。我奉上这份对战令，深知你会表现得像我们的任何一位真血指挥官一样出色。

column1: Commander, the Star Adders regard you as one of our own. I have kept this task for you, and would trust no one else to succeed.
column2: 指挥官，星蝰氏族视你为自己人。我为你留着这项任务，不放心交给任何其他人来做。

column1: Well done Commander. Know that the Clan recognizes your service, and I have transferred the agreed payment to your account.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。要知道氏族认可你的功绩，我已把约定好的报酬转入你的账户。

column1: You have failed, and this failure sets back our strategic plans for this system.  Do not expect payment, as none will be provided.
column2: 你失败了，这次失败拖累了我们在此星系战略计划的推进。别指望报酬，一分也不会有。

column1: I normally don't look down on mercenaries such as you, but your repeated actions against Stone Lion have made me question whether I should hold you all in disdain.  Take up this batchall and prove to me that mercenaries such as you are useful.
column2: 我通常不会看不起你这样的雇佣兵，但你对石狮的一再敌对，让我怀疑是否该对你们全体抱以轻蔑。接下这份对战令，向我证明你这样的雇佣兵还有用处。

column1: You have fought against Clan Stone Lion on many occasions.  Prove you can assist as well as cause harm by performing this task, and we might have further use for you.
column2: 你曾多次与石狮氏族交战。完成这项任务，证明你既能造成伤害，也能提供帮助，或许我们日后还用得上你。

column1: You have assisted Clan Stone Lion in the past, and I would like to offer you this batchall so that we can continue this relationship.
column2: 你过去曾协助过石狮氏族，我想向你提供这份对战令，好让我们的关系继续下去。

column1: Hello again, friend to the Clan.  We offer you this batchall in recognition of our friendship, and in the hopes that we can benefit each other in future.
column2: 又见面了，本氏族的朋友。为纪念我们的友谊，并期望日后彼此受益，我们向你献上这份对战令。

column1: Greetings, my friend.  You have helped me so often, I feel we should discuss the possibility of you joining the Clan yourself.  Before we do however, there is a task I would entrust to no other that you might assist us with.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。你帮了我太多，我觉得我们该谈谈你亲自加入本氏族的可能。不过在谈之前，有一件我只愿托付给你的任务想请你相助。

column1: While Stone Lion value swiftness, we don't value those who run from battle!  However I will provide a partial payment for your partial completion, so long as you do better next time.
column2: 石狮看重迅捷，可我们并不看重临阵脱逃之人！不过，只要你下次表现更好，我仍会为你的部分完成支付部分报酬。

column1: I normally don't look down on Freeborn such as you, but your repeated actions against Clan Widowmaker have made me question whether I should hold you all in disdain.  Take up this batchall and prove to me that Freeborn such as you are useful.
column2: 我通常不会看不起你这样的自由民，但你对寡妇制造者氏族的一再敌对，让我怀疑是否该对你们全体抱以轻蔑。接下这份对战令，向我证明你这样的自由民还有用处。

column1: Freeborn, you have fought against Clan Widowmaker on many occasions.  Prove you can assist as well as cause harm by performing this task, and we might have further use for you.
column2: 自由民，你曾多次与寡妇制造者氏族交战。完成这项任务，证明你既能造成伤害，也能提供帮助，或许我们日后还用得上你。

column1: Freeborn, you have assisted the Widowmakers in the past, and I would like to offer you this batchall so that we can continue this relationship.
column2: 自由民，你过去曾协助过寡妇制造者各支，我想向你提供这份对战令，好让我们的关系继续下去。

column1: Hello again, friend to Clan Widowmaker.  We offer you this batchall in recognition of our friendship, and in the hopes that we can benefit each other in future.
column2: 又见面了，寡妇制造者氏族的朋友。为纪念我们的友谊，并期望日后彼此受益，我们向你献上这份对战令。

column1: Greetings my friend.  You have helped me so often, I feel we should discuss the possibility of you joining Clan Widowmaker yourself.  Before we do however, there is a task I would entrust to no other that you might assist us with.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。你帮了我太多，我觉得我们该谈谈你亲自加入寡妇制造者氏族的可能。不过在谈之前，有一件我只愿托付给你的任务想请你相助。

column1: Well done Commander.  You were brutally effective in completing this batchall, which will benefit us both. I have transferred your c-bills as agreed.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。你以凶狠凌厉之姿完成了这份对战令，这将让我们双双受益。我已按约定把星币转入你的账户。

column1: Clan Widowmaker rewards more aggressive commanders.  You've made a valiant, yet unimpressive effort. We trust you will put your heart into it for the next battle.
column2: 寡妇制造者氏族奖赏更具攻击性的指挥官。你已付出了英勇却不够出色的努力。我们相信下一场战斗你会全力以赴。

column1: Your performance is no better than someone of the merchant caste, Commander. Perhaps you are not suited to this line of work.
column2: 你的表现不比商人种姓的人强多少，指挥官。或许你不适合干这一行。

column1: Mercenary, we understand that you have found fighting against us profitable in the past, and would like to reverse this with this batchall.
column2: 雇佣兵，我们知道你过去觉得与我们为敌有利可图，想用这份对战令扭转这一局面。

column1: Mercenary, you have fought well against us in the past.  We would like to employ your skills in a task that furthers our goals, and offer you this batchall.
column2: 雇佣兵，你过去与我们交战表现出色。我们想借重你的本事完成一项推进我们目标的任务，特此奉上这份对战令。

column1: Commander, Clan Wolf have faced you in battle before, and you have proved yourself competent.  Take up this batchall and let us work together in a mutually beneficial way.
column2: 指挥官，狼氏族曾在战斗中与你相遇，你已证明自己能力出众。接下这份对战令，让我们以互利的方式携手合作。

column1: Commander, you have assisted the Wolf Clan adequately in the past.  Before we take this relationship further, we need you to perform a task for us.
column2: 指挥官，你过去曾充分协助过狼氏族。在将这段关系推进一步之前，我们需要你为我们完成一项任务。

column1: Commander, the Wolf Clan regard you as one of our pack. I have kept this task for you, and would trust no one else to succeed.
column2: 指挥官，狼氏族视你为自己狼群的一员。我为你留着这项任务，不放心交给任何其他人来做。

column1: Well done Commander. Know that the Wolf Clan recognize your service, and I have transferred the agreed payment to your account.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。要知道狼氏族认可你的功绩，我已把约定好的报酬转入你的账户。

column1: We expect all tasks assigned to be completed. However, we recognize your attempt, and provide a partial payment for your partial completion of the tasks.
column2: 我们期望你完成交办的所有任务。不过我们认可你的尝试，为你的部分完成支付部分报酬。

column1: Commander, Clan Wolf-in-Exile has faced you in battle before, and you have proved yourself competent.  Take up this batchall and let us work together in a mutually beneficial way.
column2: 指挥官，流亡狼氏族曾在战斗中与你相遇，你已证明自己能力出众。接下这份对战令，让我们以互利的方式携手合作。

column1: Commander, you have assisted the Wolf-in-Exile adequately in the past.  Before we take this relationship further, we need you to perform a task for us.
column2: 指挥官，你过去曾充分协助过流亡狼。在将这段关系推进一步之前，我们需要你为我们完成一项任务。

column1: Commander, the Wolf-in-Exile Clan regard you as one of our pack. I have kept this task for you, and would trust no one else to succeed.
column2: 指挥官，流亡狼氏族视你为自己狼群的一员。我为你留着这项任务，不放心交给任何其他人来做。

column1: Well done, Commander. Know that the Wolf-in-Exile recognizes your service, and I have transferred the agreed payment to your account.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。要知道流亡狼认可你的功绩，我已把约定好的报酬转入你的账户。

column1: I normally don't look down on Freeborn such as you, but your repeated actions against Clan Wolverine have made me question whether I should hold you all in disdain.  Take up this batchall and prove to me that Freeborn such as you are useful.
column2: 我通常不会看不起你这样的自由民，但你对狼獾氏族的一再敌对，让我怀疑是否该对你们全体抱以轻蔑。接下这份对战令，向我证明你这样的自由民还有用处。

column1: Freeborn, you have fought against Clan Wolverine on many occasions.  Prove you can assist as well as cause harm by performing this task, and we might have further use for you.
column2: 自由民，你曾多次与狼獾氏族交战。完成这项任务，证明你既能造成伤害，也能提供帮助，或许我们日后还用得上你。

column1: Freeborn, you have assisted the Wolverines in the past, and I would like to offer you this batchall so that we can continue this relationship.
column2: 自由民，你过去曾协助过狼獾各支，我想向你提供这份对战令，好让我们的关系继续下去。

column1: Hello again, friend to Clan Wolverine.  We offer you this batchall in recognition of our friendship, and in the hopes that we can benefit each other in future.
column2: 又见面了，狼獾氏族的朋友。为纪念我们的友谊，并期望日后彼此受益，我们向你献上这份对战令。

column1: Greetings my friend.  You have helped me so often, I feel we should discuss the possibility of you joining Clan Wolverine yourself.  Before we do however, there is a task I would entrust to no other that you might assist us with.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。你帮了我太多，我觉得我们该谈谈你亲自加入狼獾氏族的可能。不过在谈之前，有一件我只愿托付给你的任务想请你相助。

column1: Clan Wolverine understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a valiant, yet ineffective effort. We trust you will do better for the next battle.
column2: 狼獾氏族明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已付出了英勇却收效甚微的努力。我们相信下一场战斗你会做得更好。

column1: Commander, the New Delphi Compact are but a few small planets desperately wishing to remain independent.  Please stop fighting against us, and instead help us with this task.
column2: 指挥官，新德尔斐协约不过是几颗拼命想要维持独立的小行星。请别再与我们为敌，转而帮我们完成这项任务吧。

column1: Commander, if you have been attacking the planets of the New Delphi Compact for money, we can offer you similar contracts that will preserve our independence, and I beg you to consider this one.
column2: 指挥官，若你攻打新德尔斐协约的星球是为了钱，我们能提供报酬相当、又能保全我们独立的合约，恳请你考虑这一份。

column1: Welcome to the New Delphi Compact, Commander.  I have a task for you to undertake, if you would like to help preserve our independence.  You will of course be adequately compensated for your efforts.
column2: 欢迎来到新德尔斐协约，指挥官。若你愿意帮助我们维持独立，我有一项任务交给你。你的付出自会得到充分的报酬。

column1: Thank you again for your help in protecting the New Delphi Compact's independence, Commander.  We would like to employ you once more to defend our sovereignty and independence, if you are able?
column2: 再次感谢你协助保护新德尔斐协约的独立，指挥官。若你方便，我们想再度聘请你捍卫我们的主权与独立。

column1: Welcome friend of the New Delphi Compact.  You have helped us many times in the past, and hope you can take on this contract to assist us in preserving our independence once more.
column2: 欢迎你，新德尔斐协约的朋友。你过去已多次相助，希望你接下这份合约，再度协助我们维持独立。

column1: The Oracle speaks highly of you, saviour of the New Delphi Compact.  You have done so much for us I feel embarrassed to ask for your help again, however I assure you that you will be well paid for your efforts.
column2: 神谕对你赞誉有加，新德尔斐协约的救星。你为我们做得太多，我都不好意思再求你相助，但我向你保证，你的付出会得到丰厚报偿。

column1: Commander, the children of the New Delphi Compact are being enslaved as we speak due to your inability to complete this task.  Please don't harm our relationship further by seeking payment.
column2: 指挥官，正因为你无法完成这项任务，新德尔斐协约的孩子们此刻正被卖为奴隶。请不要再索要报酬，进一步伤害我们的关系。

column1: We both know the score, Commander. House Humphreys relies on you like you're one of our own, and you've always been happy to help us out. I hope you can see fit to agree this time as well—this is a job too important for lesser warriors.
column2: 我们彼此心知肚明，指挥官。汉弗莱家族倚重你，待你如自己人，而你也一直乐于助我们一臂之力。希望这次你同样可以应允——这份活儿太重要，不能交给庸手。

column1: Commander, please!  We have endured enough of your deprivations and attacks on our faith, and our community.  In the name of the One Star, will you please turn your attentions elsewhere if we pay you?
column2: 指挥官，求你了！我们受够了你对我们信仰与社群的掠夺和攻击。以独星之名，若我们付你钱，你能不能把注意力转向别处？

column1: Commander, the Elysian Fields are but a few small planets desperately wishing to retain our peaceful way of life.  Please stop fighting against us, and instead help us with this task.
column2: 指挥官，极乐之地不过是几颗拼命想要维持和平生活方式的星球。请别再与我们为敌，转而帮我们完成这项任务吧。

column1: Commander, if you have been attacking the planets of the Elysian Fields for money, we can offer you similar contracts that will preserve our way of life, and I beg you to consider this one.
column2: 指挥官，若你攻打极乐之地的星球是为了钱，我们能提供报酬相当、又能保全我们生活方式的合约，恳请你考虑这一份。

column1: Welcome to the Elysian Fields, Commander.  We of the One Star faith are simple subsistence farmers and hunter/gathers, and normally have no need for martial forces.  With this task however, you can help, if you wish.
column2: 欢迎来到极乐之地，指挥官。我们独星信仰的信众都是简单的自给自足农人与狩猎采集者，平时并不需要武力。不过这项任务，若你愿意，可以助我们一臂之力。

column1: Thank you again for your help in protecting the faithful of the Elysian Fields, Commander.  We would like to employ you once more to defend our faith and way of life, if you are able?
column2: 再次感谢你协助保护极乐之地的信众，指挥官。若你方便，我们想再度聘请你捍卫我们的信仰与生活方式。

column1: Welcome blessed friend of the Elysian Fields.  You have helped us many times in the past, and hope you can take on this contract to assist us in preserving our way of life once more.
column2: 欢迎你，极乐之地受祝福的朋友。你过去已多次相助，希望你接下这份合约，再度协助我们维护生活方式。

column1: The One Star bless and keep you well Commander. You have done so much for the One Star faith I feel embarrassed to ask for your help again, however I assure you that you will be well paid for your efforts.
column2: 愿独星保佑看护你，指挥官。你为独星信仰做得太多，我都不好意思再求你相助，但我向你保证，你的付出会得到丰厚报偿。

column1: Thank you Commander, and bless you for your assistance.  Payment for your help has already been transferred to your account.
column2: 谢谢你，指挥官，愿主赐福于你的援手。你应得的报酬已经转入你的账户。

column1: Commander, we appreciate all the help you can provide, but we can only pay you for tasks completed. May the One Star guide you to a more successful result next time.
column2: 指挥官，我们感激你能提供的所有帮助，但我们只能为你完成的任务付钱。愿独星引导你下次取得更圆满的结果。

column1: Commander, The light of the One Star can not reach those shrouded in their own darkness, and our c-bills cannot reach those who can't perform the tasks they are contracted to.  Good day!
column2: 指挥官，独星之光无法照及身陷自身黑暗之人，而我们的星币也无法付给完不成合约任务之人。日安！

column1: Your dishonorable ways are well known to the Escorpion Imperio, however you might be of service.  Take this batchall, and show me that you can be of service.
column2: 你的无耻行径在埃斯科皮翁帝国早已尽人皆知，不过你或许还有点用处。接下这份对战令，向我证明你的价值。

column1: You have assisted the Escorpion Imperio in the past, and I would like to offer you this batchall so that we can continue this relationship.
column2: 你过去曾协助过埃斯科皮翁帝国，我想向你提供这份对战令，好让我们的关系继续下去。

column1: Hello again, friend to the Escorpion Imperio.  While there is certainly trust between us, I would like you to take this batchall to show your sincerity before we share all our secrets with you.
column2: 又见面了，埃斯科皮翁帝国的朋友。我们之间确有信任，但在与你分享我们的全部秘密之前，我希望你先接下这份对战令以示诚意。

column1: Greetings friend.  You have proven your value to the Escorpion Imperio many times.  I have a task I would entrust to no other, and perhaps afterwards we shall share some necrosa?
column2: 你好，朋友。你已多次向埃斯科皮翁帝国证明自己的价值。我有一件只愿托付给你的任务，也许完成后我们会共饮些死后迷幻药？

column1: Commander, {COMPANY.CompanyName} has never served the Federated Commonwealth before, so we have no record of your reliability. Take this contract and show us you can uphold the standards of FedCom forces.
column2: 指挥官，{COMPANY.CompanyName}此前从未为联邦联邦效力，我们因此没有你们可靠性的记录。接下这份合约，向我们证明你们能维护联邦联邦部队的标准。

column1: Your exploits are known across neighboring realms, even if you haven't fought for the Commonwealth yet. We see potential utility in your skills; examine this contract and demonstrate your worth.
column2: 即便你尚未为联邦而战，你的功业也已传遍邻近诸国。我们看出你的才干有潜在用处；审视这份合约，证明你的价值吧。

column1: Though we have had limited dealings, your performance elsewhere suggests competence and discipline. The Federated Commonwealth will consider further engagements should you complete this mission satisfactorily.
column2: 尽管我们往来有限，但你在别处的表现显示出能力与纪律。若你能圆满完成这项任务，联邦联邦将考虑后续的聘用。

column1: Commander, your past service alongside FedCom assets was effective and contributed to our objectives. We extend this contract in confidence of your continued effectiveness.
column2: 指挥官，你过去与联邦联邦部队并肩作战颇有成效，为我们的目标作出了贡献。我们怀着对你持续效能的信心献上这份合约。

column1: Greetings again, Commander. Your reliability and battlefield performance have earned the Commonwealth's respect. We present this contract in recognition of your proven capabilities.
column2: 又见面了，指挥官。你的可靠与战场表现已赢得联邦的尊重。为表彰你经证实的才干，我们献上这份合约。

column1: Commander, {COMPANY.CompanyName} stands among the more dependable mercenary groups the Federated Commonwealth has enlisted. We trust your execution and value your contributions to our joint goals.
column2: 指挥官，{COMPANY.CompanyName}跻身联邦联邦所征募的众多可靠雇佣兵部队之列。我们信任你的执行力，也珍视你对我们共同目标的贡献。

column1: Commander, you are one of the top mercenary companies the Commonwealth prefers to hire—proven, disciplined, and formidable. Here is another critical contract, and we expect excellence as always.
column2: 指挥官，你是联邦最中意雇佣的顶级佣兵之一——经受过考验、纪律严明、令人敬畏。这又是份关键合约，我们照例期待卓越的表现。

column1: Exceptional work, Commander. Your success directly furthers the Federated Commonwealth's strategic aims, and your payment has been authorized with commendations to your company.
column2: 出类拔萃，指挥官。你的成功直接推进了联邦联邦的战略目标，你的报酬已获批准，并对贵公司致以嘉奖。

column1: Commander, the Federated Commonwealth understands that even capable warriors face unforeseen challenges. Though the objectives weren't all met, we acknowledge your effort and will provide partial payment.
column2: 指挥官，联邦联邦明白，即便能干的战士也会遭遇无法预见的挑战。虽然目标并未全部达成，但我们认可你的努力，将支付部分报酬。

column1: Commander, this outcome falls far below the Federated Commonwealth's standards. Your conduct on the field was negligent, and as a result, no payment will be issued. Rebuild your discipline before engaging FedCom interests again.
column2: 指挥官，此次结果远低于联邦联邦的标准。你在战场上的行为堪称疏忽，因此不会支付任何报酬。在与联邦联邦利益再有交集之前，先重建你的纪律。

column1: Our resources are limited, and we require external assistance. Your expertise is needed for this mission; compensation will be discussed upon successful completion.
column2: 我们资源有限，需要外部援助。这项任务需要你的专长；成功完成后我们将商谈报酬。

column1: Despite any past differences, the Ferris Collective believes in mutually beneficial collaborations. Let's set aside prior disagreements and work together for our common interests.
column2: 纵有过往分歧，费里斯共同体仍相信互利合作。让我们搁置宿怨，为共同利益携手。

column1: Greetings, Commander. The Collective has a mission that aligns with your skills. Review this contract; your efforts will be duly compensated.
column2: 您好，指挥官。共同体有一项与您的技能相符的任务。请审阅这份合约，您的付出将得到应有的报偿。

column1: The Ferris Collective seeks capable mercenaries for an upcoming operation. Your reputation suggests you're well-suited for the task. Are you interested?
column2: 费里斯共同体正为一次即将展开的行动物色能干的雇佣兵。你的名声显示你很适合这项任务。你感兴趣吗？

column1: Commander, our previous collaborations have been fruitful. Let's continue this successful partnership. Please review the attached contract; we trust it meets your expectations.
column2: 指挥官，我们此前的合作颇有成效。让我们延续这段成功的伙伴关系。请审阅随附的合约，我们相信它会符合你的期望。

column1: Commander, the Ferris Collective requires your expertise once more. We have a mission suited to your capabilities, with competitive compensation as always. We hope you accept
column2: 指挥官，费里斯共同体再次需要你的专长。我们有一项与你能力相称的任务，报酬照旧富有竞争力。希望你能接受。

column1: Commander, your consistent reliability has made you an integral ally to the Collective. Undertake this mission, and you can expect rewards commensurate with your valued contributions.
column2: 指挥官，你一贯的可靠使你成为共同体不可或缺的盟友。接下这项任务，你所珍视的贡献将得到相应的回报。

column1: Splendid work, Commander! The Ferris Collective is impressed with your results. Payment has been sent, and we look forward to seeing you again soon—there's always work for allies like you.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官！费里斯共同体对你的成果印象深刻。报酬已发出，期待不久后再见到你——对你这样的盟友，活儿总是有的。

column1: Commander, you made an honest attempt, and while the mission fell short, we acknowledge your effort. Things don't always go as planned, but we appreciate your dedication nonetheless.
column2: 指挥官，你确实作出了诚实的尝试，任务虽未达成，但我们认可你的努力。事情并非总如人意，但你的投入我们依然感激。

column1: Commander, your performance has been nothing short of disappointing. No payment will be issued for such failure. Consider this a warning; improvement is necessary if we are to work together in the future.
column2: 指挥官，你的表现简直令人失望。这般失败不会获得任何报酬。权当一次警告：若我们要继续合作，改进必不可少。

column1: Mercenary though you may be, you seem effective enough. The Coalition has need of your skills, Commander.
column2: 虽说你只是个雇佣兵，但看起来还算能干。同盟需要你的本事，指挥官。

column1: Greetings, Commander. The Coalition requires aid from someone outside of our own forces. Hopefully you can help us.
column2: 您好，指挥官。同盟需要来自我们自身部队之外的援助。希望您能帮上忙。

column1: The Coalition requires mercenaries of skill, Commander, and you fit the bill nicely. With luck, we will both profit from this arrangement.
column2: 同盟需要有本事的雇佣兵，指挥官，您正合适。运气好的话，我们双方都能从这桩安排中获利。

column1: Greetings, Commander. Once again, the Coalition requires your services. Should you be successful, we will both profit.
column2: 您好，指挥官。同盟再次需要您的效力。若您成功，我们双方都将获利。

column1: Honored friend! Your acts in service to the Coalition have not been forgotten. In light of this, we present you with this choice contract.
column2: 尊敬的朋友！您为同盟效力的事迹我们不曾遗忘。有鉴于此，我们向您奉上这份精选合约。

column1: Excellent performance, Commander. The Filtvelt Coalition are pleased with what you have accomplished and the skill you've evidenced. Expect our payment in full!
column2: 精彩的表现，指挥官。菲尔特维尔特同盟对你所取得的成就与展现的技艺十分满意。敬请期待我们的全额报酬！

column1: Well, let it never be said the Coalition does not believe in charity. Obviously, your skills could not be equivalent to our own regular armies—so we do not blame you for your inability to complete the contract.
column2: 好吧，可别让人说同盟不行善举。显而易见，你的本事无法与我们正规军相提并论——所以我们也就不怪你完不成合约了。

column1: I don't know why we bother offering you contracts, to be perfectly honest. It's obvious you're not a friend to the Finmark Free Republic, but desperate times require desperate measures, so we have to scrape the bottom of the barrel.
column2: 说实话，我不知道我们何必费心给你合约。你显然不是芬马克自由共和国的朋友，但危难之时须用非常手段，所以我们只能到桶底去刮渣了。

column1: The Finmark Free Republic has a use for mercenaries like you, Commander. I think you'll be interested in the attached contract. Hopefully you will find it to your liking.
column2: 芬马克自由共和国用得上你这样的雇佣兵，指挥官。我想你会对随附的合约感兴趣。希望它能合你心意。

column1: The Finmark Free Republic would like to offer you a choice contract, Commander. As the leader of a respected mercenary company, you should find the terms both fair and equitable, I think.
column2: 芬马克自由共和国想向你提供一份精选合约，指挥官。作为一支受尊敬的雇佣兵公司的首领，我想你会觉得条款既公道又公平。

column1: Commander, I hope this message finds you well. The people of the Finmark Free Republic would like to offer a contract to you, owing to our respect for your skills. Please consider it carefully.
column2: 指挥官，愿此信送达时您一切安好。芬马克自由共和国的人民出于对您才干的敬重，想向您提供一份合约。请仔细考虑。

column1: Greetings, my friend. This contract is not one we would offer to a lesser mercenary, but you've proven your loyalty, prowess, and dedication to the ideals of the Finmark Free Republic. Please accept our offer.
column2: 你好，我的朋友。这份合约我们不会提供给次一等的雇佣兵，但你已证明了自己对芬马克自由共和国理想的忠诚、勇武与奉献。请接受我们的提议。

column1: We both know the score, Commander. The Republic relies on you like you're one of our own, and you've always been happy to help us out. I hope you will agree to complete this contract as it is suitable to one of your stature.
column2: 我们彼此心知肚明，指挥官。共和国倚重你，待你如自己人，而你也一直乐于助我们一臂之力。希望你愿意完成这份与你的地位相称的合约。

column1: Top-tier work, Commander — The Republic is very happy with your performance. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 一流的活计，指挥官——共和国对你的表现非常满意。继续保持，我会确保有更多活儿找上你。

column1: The Finmark Free Republic understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. It was a valiant effort, even though it failed. Carry this loss with you so the knowledge can be used to win the next one.
column2: 芬马克自由共和国明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。这是场英勇的努力，虽然失败了。带着这次失利前行，让教训助你赢得下一场。

column1: Commander, not every battle ends in victory, but the Galatean League values the effort you've put forth. Learn from this defeat and return stronger—we know you're capable.
column2: 指挥官，并非每场战斗都以胜利告终，但加拉特联盟珍视你付出的努力。从这次失败中汲取教训，归来时更强——我们知道你有这个本事。

column1: Commander, your lackluster performance has been a serious disappointment. The League cannot tolerate such ineptitude—improve your methods or don't bother answering future calls for aid.
column2: 指挥官，你平淡乏味的表现令人大失所望。联盟无法容忍这等无能——改进你的方法，否则就别回应我们未来的求援了。

column1: Your insistence on opposing the Bear has not gone unnoticed, mercenary.  However, I am generous.  You can begin to make amends with this batchall.
column2: 你执意与熊为敌，这事我们不会视而不见，雇佣兵。不过我心胸宽厚，你可以从接下这份对战令开始弥补。

column1: The Bear has faced you in battle before, and you are a competent warrior.  Take up this batchall and perhaps we can find a more common purpose.
column2: 熊曾在战斗中与你相遇，你也是位能干的战士。接下这份对战令，或许我们能找到共同的目标。

column1: You have assisted the Bear in the past, and I would like to offer you this batchall so that we can continue this relationship.
column2: 你过去曾协助过熊，我想向你提供这份对战令，好让我们的关系继续下去。

column1: Hello again, friend to the Dominion.  We offer you this batchall in recognition of our kinship.
column2: 又见面了，联邦的朋友。为纪念我们的亲缘，我们向你献上这份对战令。

column1: Greetings, my brother.  You have helped me so often, I almost look at you as a member of my own family.  I have this choice batchall for you, if you are interested.
column2: 你好，我的兄弟。你帮我太多次，我几乎把你当作自己的家人。我这里有份精选对战令，不知你是否感兴趣。

column1: Well done Commander.  The satisfactory completion of this batchall will benefit the Bear, and I have transferred your c-bills as agreed.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。这份对战令的圆满完成将惠及熊，我已按约定把星币转入你的账户。

column1: You clearly lacked the strength to complete all the objectives. However, I will provide a partial payment for your partial completion, so long as you do better next time.
column2: 你显然缺乏完成所有目标的力量。不过，只要你下次表现更好，我仍会为你的部分完成支付部分报酬。

column1: Commander, you have constantly been a thorn in the side of the Hanseatic League's desire for mutually profitable trade.  However, if you desire C-Bills so badly, we do have this contract you can undertake.
column2: 指挥官，你一直如芒刺在背，妨碍着汉萨同盟互利贸易的愿望。不过，若你真那么想要星币，我们确实有这份合约可以交给你。

column1: Commander, your attacks against the Hanseatic League have done little to engender trust between us; perhaps we can reverse this trend with this contract?
column2: 指挥官，你对汉萨同盟的袭击几乎没能为我们之间赢得任何信任；也许我们能借这份合约扭转这一局面？

column1: Commander, the Hanseatic League is a mercantile alliance; we are traders.  Rather than attack us, let us work together for mutual benefit.
column2: 指挥官，汉萨同盟是个商业联盟；我们是商人。与其攻打我们，不如为互利而携手合作。

column1: Greetings Commander.  The Hanseatic League has a task requiring a lance of mercenaries such as yours, shall we negotiate on a payment for your services?
column2: 您好，指挥官。汉萨同盟有一项任务需要你这样的小队雇佣兵，我们是否该谈谈你效力的报酬？

column1: Greetings again Commander.  The Hanseatic League once again have a small matter you can assist with, if you would care to negotiate a mutually agreeable payment?
column2: 又见面了，指挥官。汉萨同盟再次有桩小事可以请你相助，你是否愿意谈谈一份双方都能接受的报酬？

column1: Hello again, friend of the Hanseatic League.  I have kept this profitable contract aside in hopes of meeting with you, shall we discuss it further?
column2: 又见面了，汉萨同盟的朋友。我特意把这单有利可图的合约留到你到来，我们不妨详谈？

column1: Greetings my trusted friend.  We have both profited greatly from our past dealings, so much so that I have this one task that I will pay you handsomely if you can complete for me.
column2: 你好，我信赖的朋友。我们过去的交易让双方都获利甚丰，正因为如此，我这有一项任务，你若能完成，我定会慷慨付酬。

column1: Well done Commander.  The satisfactory completion of this contract will benefit us greatly, and we have transferred your c-bills to your account.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。这份合约的圆满完成将让我们大受裨益，我们已把星币转入你的账户。

column1: You are aware that a fulfilling a contract requires you to complete the primary objective?  In the spirit of good faith, we will provide a partial payment this time, please don't let it happen again.
column2: 你应当明白，履行合约要求你完成主要目标吧？本着善意，这次我们会提供部分报酬，请别再让这种事发生。
